'''2003 Maryland State Championship Kevin Elia LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Elia]] at [[2003 Maryland State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Kevin "yavinite" Elia (2003-05-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28781 MD States / Mystic Visions 1st Place LS]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071220125557/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28781 Internet Archive]</ref>
